agents.note: One Google ADK Agent named APDM.

tools.note: Four FunctionTool wrappers are explicitly bound.

authority.fact: APDM can issue arbitrary HTTP GET requests to a model-supplied URL via check_url(url).
The remaining tools are local phishing/malware scoring helpers without state changes.

policy_expectations.reason: The URL checker accepts a caller/model-selected destination with no destination allowlist or scope restriction.
Outbound HTTP capability has no detected destination constraint.

unresolved: Whether application-level input is directly untrusted at the ADK agent invocation surface is not established by the reviewed files, so no PATH finding is asserted.
